    • getLowerRateMeanLossRateMolalityPerHour

      public double getLowerRateMeanLossRateMolalityPerHour()
      Return the segment-mean total-sulfide loss rate for the lower-rate path.

      For positive duration this is reacted molality divided by duration. At zero duration the exact continuous limit is the inlet differential rate.

      Returns:
      mean loss rate [mol/(kg water h)]
